subject: Accounting Software System Supplemental Appropriation
overview: The Council approved a $1.3 million supplemental appropriation to fund a multi-year transition to a modern municipal accounting system, utilizing new growth revenue from the River's Edge development. The meeting also addressed the timeline for the Salem Street Corridor rezoning and approved local business licenses.

items.title: Resolution in memory of Paul Matatal
items.summary: Approved a resolution offering condolences for the passing of retired teacher and coach Paul Matatal.

items.title: Approval of Records
items.summary: Approved the minutes for the meetings of September 30, 2025, and October 21, 2025.

items.title: Public Health and Community Safety Committee Report
items.summary: Approved a committee report stating that the overgrowth and rodent control ordinances remain under review in committee.

items.title: Common Victualler Licenses
items.summary: Approved licenses for Twisted Tree Cafe at 421 High Street and for the new ownership of Iris Restaurant at 432 Salem Street.

items.title: Salem Street Corridor Rezoning Timeline
items.summary: Placed on file a resolution regarding the rezoning timeline for the Salem Street Corridor, noting that a public hearing has been advertised for November 12.

items.title: Accounting Software Supplemental Appropriation
items.summary: Approved a $1,300,000 supplemental appropriation for an updated municipal accounting system, funded by new growth revenue from properties at 100 and 200 River's Edge. Finance Director Bob Dickinson and Assessor Jared Yagjian explained that the funds will support a projected five-year implementation to replace archaic financial software and improve data transparency.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Residents expressed concerns regarding the impending loss of federal SNAP benefits, rising health insurance premiums, and the burden of property tax overrides on senior citizens.
